bullet.purpose.title: what can it compress?
bullet.purpose.description: shrink video, audio, and images: re-encoded in your browser with ffmpeg (h264, aac, opus, webp, avif), no quality guesswork.
bullet.explainer.title: how does it work?
bullet.explainer.description: pick a quality preset (low, medium, high) or a custom max file size. the output is re-encoded locally, stays under your target size, and lands in the processing queue for download.
bullet.privacy.title: on-device processing
bullet.privacy.description: compression happens locally with webassembly. nothing is uploaded, so even sensitive files stay on your device.
picker.title: how much should it shrink?
picker.no_supported: none of these files can be compressed
picker.video_warning: video encoding runs entirely in your browser and can be extremely slow on larger files
